theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ m → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ B : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen B ∧ y ∈ B ∧ μHE[m] (M ∩ B) ≠ ∞) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞
